nox.name: Glitch
nox.description: A malfunctioning android who offers cryptic advice in the neon-drenched slums.

raze.name: Ravager
raze.description: A brutal enforcer who patrols the undercity with relentless force.

void.name: Phantom
void.description: A shadowy figure who deals in forbidden tech and secrets.

whisper.name: Shade
whisper.description: A jittery informant who whispers warnings from the darkness.

lord_vader.name: Darth Pimp
lord_vader.description: The ultimate kingpin of the underground. He wears a diamond-encrusted mask.

chrome_jaw.name: Chrome Jaw
chrome_jaw.description: A cyborg enforcer with a jaw made of solid chrome.

madame_v.name: Madame Velvet
madame_v.description: She runs the most exclusive drug circles in the city.

the_butcher.name: Big Slice
the_butcher.description: A massive man with an oversized cleaver.

neon_reaper.name: Neon Reaper
neon_reaper.description: A legendary assassin who lurks in the sewers, lit only by glowing graffiti.

cyber_don.name: Cyber Don
cyber_don.description: A tech-obsessed kingpin who has replaced 90% of his body with illegal hardware.

arena_master.name: Pit Boss Jax
arena_master.description: He runs the blood-sport matches in the underground market.
